turns.learner: Hello! I want to practise writing a paragraph in English, please.
turns.tutor:
Hello! Great, let's start. A good paragraph has a topic sentence (the main idea) and supporting sentences (more details).

Try this: write a topic sentence for a paragraph about "why sleep matters". Please include the word sleep.

turns.learner: I sleep eight hours every night. I feel good in the morning.
turns.tutor:
Good sentences, and they use sleep! But a topic sentence states the main idea for everyone, not only your own habit. Compare: "Sleep is important for good health."

Can you write a topic sentence like that about why sleep matters?

turns.learner: But isn't it better to start with my own life? Like I sleep early because I study. It is more interesting for the reader.
turns.tutor:
Personal details are useful, but as support, not as the opening. The topic sentence tells the reader what the whole paragraph is about.

Try: "Sleep is important for students." Then add your detail: "For example, I sleep early because I study."

Can you write your own topic sentence now?

turns.learner: Okay, I see. Sleep is very important for our brain. Is this a topic sentence?
turns.tutor:
Yes! It states the main idea and uses sleep. Well done.

Now add one supporting sentence. Start with "For example" or "because". Remember, your own detail can go here, for example how sleep helps you study.

turns.learner: For example, I sleep early because I study for exams and I remember more when I sleep well.
turns.tutor:
Very good! That is a clear supporting sentence with "For example" and "because". Your personal detail works well here.

Now add a second supporting sentence. Try starting with "Also".

turns.learner: Also, sleep gives us energy for the day, so we feel happy and can focus in class.
turns.tutor:
Excellent! Now you have a full paragraph: a topic sentence ("Sleep is very important for our brain"), then two supporting sentences with "For example" and "Also".

Remember: start with the main idea, then add your details. Great work today!
